purpose: Disentangle first-prefix Clip topology/import correction and OBEY flag; no complete-model retry
source_scope: Known 11-node ONE first Conv+SiLU+two activation Q/DQ boundaries; output second activation DQ; secondConv excluded

factors.topology: Original FLOAT Clip->Q->DQ unchanged OR Q->INT8Clip[-127,+127]->DQ plus both imported Clip alpha/beta corrections; no other graph changes
factors.flag: Both OBEY and PREFER cleared for none; only OBEY enabled for obey; query actual config.get_flag values

parser_metadata_required: Every layer precision_is_set and every output output_type_is_set before and after only Clip bounds correction; record explicit values only when set; preserve all unsupported/error states
build_failure_policy: Record each compiler failure with exact rc/log/result and proceed to next frozen case only after child exited; never execute failed engine or retry; timeout/resource guard/stale state/outer interrupt aborts remaining cases with cleanup
execution_policy: Only successfully built/deserialized engines with exact static bindings; save sole Conv inspector and two raw outputs, finite state, repeat equality, CPU descriptive deltas and topology/flag paired comparisons
actual_precision_review: Independently inspect sole Conv input/weight/output types and named integer tactic, activation/fusion identity; no engine name or requested flag is actual INT8 proof

outcome_interpretation.build_failure_reproduced: Evidence only for this local prefix context, not a complete detector proof
outcome_interpretation.all_small_cases_build: Failure not reproduced here; OBEY alone on this prefix insufficient, full q_all incompatibility remains unresolved
outcome_interpretation.output_flag_difference: Descriptive raw and fusion/tactic differences; no newly chosen numerical acceptance tolerance
outcome_interpretation.completion: Four outcomes saved or explicit safe abort with final process/resource records; not Gate PASS
